appliesWhen.label: trains at least twice a week

timing.note: Day-to-day consistency matters; timing relative to the workout does not. Recorded explicitly BECAUSE it is folklore - if the field were absent the routine builder would be free to invent a post-workout rule that the evidence does not support.

review.note: Loading phase (20 g/day for 5-7 days) deliberately NOT implemented for the MVP: it is a second dosing regime with its own timing split, and the maintenance dose reaches the same saturation within about four weeks.
